verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents connecting a Google or Outlook calendar, and it shows no per-meeting-type rules for automatic capture. The closest items are organization-wide recording policies and users manually choosing when to record, pause, or resume. These are adjacent controls, not the auto-capture rules this story asks for.

support.subject: As a product manager, I connect Google or Outlook calendar once and control per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured automatically
